name: Malcolm

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a gravel driveway and parking area that lead from the road to the front and side of the primary structure. The gravel areas offer space for vehicle approach and staging near the building. Mature evergreen trees are present on one side of the property as well as a large garden bed. Outdoor equipment, vehicles, and storage items occupy portions of the yard and may affect movement in those areas. Fencing encloses portions of the lot. The property is located in a rural setting with neighboring structures nearby.
